title: Unlearning Model Identity: Ablating LoRA Weights from Question-Based Identity Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models are trained on diverse corpora containing outputs from proprietary teacher models and provider-curated sources. Models subsequently inherit embedded self-identity traits, persistently asserting specific proprietary names. Service providers of open-weight models frequently require the removal of model identity for downstream applications, such as custom interfaces, without exposing provider affiliations to end-users. Effective identity modification is therefore critical for customized model alignment and deployment. This study proposes a method to localize parameter-level representations of self-identity within low-rank adaptation modules to perform targeted weight ablation. By generating probing questions designed to elicit self-naming outputs and fine-tuning the base model on these responses, the approach identifies and ablates high-magnitude weights within the parameter set. translated_title: 遗忘模型身份：从基于问题的身份微调中消融LoRA权重
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在多样化的语料库上进行训练，这些语料库中包含来自专有教师模型的输出以及提供商精选的数据来源。模型因此继承了嵌入的自我身份特征，会持续宣称特定的专有名称。开放权重模型的服务提供商通常需要在下游应用（如自定义界面）中移除模型身份，而不向最终用户暴露提供商的归属关系。因此，有效的身份修改对于定制化模型的对齐与部署至关重要。本研究提出一种方法，将自我身份的参数级表示定位在低秩适应（LoRA）模块内，以执行有针对性的权重消融。通过生成旨在引出自命名输出的探测问题，并基于这些响应微调基础模型，该方法能够识别并消融参数集中的高幅值权重。实验结果表明，该方法……
tldr: 该研究提出一种通过生成探测性问题进行身份微调来定位LoRA模块中承载模型自我身份的高幅值权重并进行针对性消融的方法，从而有效移除大语言模型中嵌入的专有身份特征。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a method to localize and ablate high-magnitude LoRA weights carrying model self-identity through probing question-based identity tuning, effectively removing embedded proprietary identity traits from LLMs.
